note: Moments cut from the owner's own published videos and clips (YouTube @halmic, Twitch halmictv). Source footage is not in the repo; download video-only up to 1080p (see README.md). Times are source seconds. crop (landscape, 16:9) and pcrop (portrait, 9:16) are w:h:x:y in a 1280x720 reference frame (scaled to the real source size) and always exclude HUD text, captions, credits and facecam.
